blinding.statement: Real-data outputs were inspected during pipeline development. Final tracer definitions, separation/redshift bins, nuisance model, production seed and independent closure seeds were fixed before the final closure tests. The later 256-permutation extension changed only the size of the frozen-geometry null ensemble. No result is described as a blinded measurement.

primary_observational_inference.estimator: full-sample five-tracer luminosity-rank conservative nuisance-projected DESI DR1 dipole fit
primary_observational_inference.single_sentence_rationale: This is the sole headline observational coefficient because it is the direct frozen real-data analysis with the null ensemble extended from 32 to 256 permutations; Gfinder, EZmock, AbacusSummit, stochastic-seed and ell=3 results are validation/control layers rather than alternative headline estimates.

permutation_refinement.changed_quantity: number of frozen-geometry luminosity-mark permutations only

ezmock_random_rank_placebo.reason_not_primary: The released EZmock files used here do not provide the luminosity field required for the physical luminosity-ranked tracer construction.

abacus_physical_mock_calibration.reason_not_primary: The ensemble contains 25 mocks for an 18-dimensional vector and the inferred significance is covariance-estimator dependent: OAS gives -1.779 sigma while the raw-sample/Hartlap control gives -0.722 sigma. This layer is therefore retained as physical-mock validation, not as the headline likelihood.

ell3_octupole_control.condition_number_definition: cond(C_reg), where C_reg = C_JK + r I and r = max(1e-7 lambda_max(C_JK), 1e-6 median(diag(C_JK)), 1e-14); this is not the raw covariance condition number.

provenance_guardrails: There is exactly one headline observational coefficient: the full-sample luminosity-rank conservative DESI dipole fit.
The 256-permutation result refines only the permutation-null calibration of the frozen production estimator and is not a new optimization.
Gfinder, EZmock, AbacusSummit, stochastic-seed and ell=3 outputs are validation/control layers, not alternative headline estimates.
EZmock is a random-rank geometry/covariance/placebo ensemble, not a luminosity-matched physical covariance.
AbacusSummit is the physical luminosity-ranked high-fidelity mock layer; the final ensemble contains 25 completed realizations.
The ell=3 condition number 440.8145 refers to the ridge-regularized jackknife covariance used for inversion, not the raw covariance.
The conservative nuisance-projected DESI result is the production inference; the minimal two-template fit is retained only as a diagnostic.
The Abacus amplitude sweep is a compressed-vector / forward-window linear-response validation, not an independent catalog-level signal injection before pair compression.
No observational result is presented as a neutrino-wake detection.
